hints.title: One level at a time
hints.body: The depth is the number of levels in the tree.

hints.title: Recursive view
hints.body: The depth of a node is one plus the larger depth of its children.

hints.title: Iterative view
hints.body: Carry the current depth alongside each node in a stack or queue.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if root is null: return 0
best = 0
stack = [(root, 1)]
while stack is not empty:
    node, depth = pop()
    best = max(best, depth)
    push existing children with depth + 1
return best
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
